title: Remove base44 platform dependency — ports + local adapters

done: src/api/base44Client.js — infrastructure client to be deleted
src/lib/AuthContext.jsx — auth surface slated for removal

steps.name: Strip base44 auth surface
steps.description: Delete src/lib/AuthContext.jsx and src/components/UserNotRegisteredError.jsx. Rewrite src/App.jsx to drop AuthProvider/useAuth/UserNotRegisteredError wrapper (keep QueryClientProvider + Router + Toaster). Rewrite src/lib/PageNotFound.jsx to remove base44.auth.me and the admin-branch note.
steps.done_condition: App.jsx has no AuthProvider, useAuth, or UserNotRegisteredError. No file under src/ imports base44.auth.*. hex analyze still passes.

steps.name: IntegrationStoragePort + LocalStorageIntegrationAdapter
steps.description: Add IntegrationStoragePort to src/core/ports/index.ts with list/create/update/delete returning Promise<Integration[]> / Promise<Integration>. Add Integration domain type. Implement src/adapters/secondary/localstorage-integration-adapter.ts backed by window.localStorage (JSON-serialized, namespaced key 'apidiff.integrations.v1'). Wire into composition-root.ts. Create a React hook src/lib/useIntegrationStore.js that exposes the port via useQuery/useMutation. Swap src/pages/Settings.jsx and src/components/sidebar/IntegrationList.jsx from base44.entities.Integration.* to the hook.
steps.done_condition: Settings page loads, saves, deletes integrations via localStorage. No import of base44 in Settings.jsx or IntegrationList.jsx. hex analyze clean.

steps.name: SpecProxyPort + Vercel Function + browser fallback
steps.description: Add SpecProxyPort to core/ports. Primary implementation: a new Vercel Function at api/proxy-fetch.ts that accepts { url } and returns { document, status }. Browser adapter src/adapters/secondary/browser-proxy-adapter.ts attempts direct fetch first, falls back to the Vercel function on CORS failure. Wire via composition-root. Expose through a useSpecProxy hook. Swap fetch-spec.js, VersionPicker.jsx, SpecInput.jsx from base44.functions.invoke('proxyFetch') to the hook.
steps.done_condition: URL-based spec loading works for both same-origin and CORS-restricted sources. Vercel Function deployed or dev-mode stub in place. No call-site imports base44 for proxy fetch.

steps.name: DiscoveryPort wiring (leverage existing adapters)
steps.description: Expose the existing src/adapters/secondary/*-discovery-adapter.ts chain through a DiscoveryPort in core/ports. Wire all discovery adapters (github, apisguru, docusaurus, url, changelog-parser) into composition-root. Add useDiscovery hook. Swap DiscoveryPanel.jsx from base44.functions.invoke('discoverApi') to the hook. Delete any base44-side discoverApi logic.
steps.done_condition: DiscoveryPanel runs against in-browser discovery adapters. No base44.functions.invoke calls remain anywhere in src/.

steps.name: Delete base44 package + teach analyzer the React boundary
steps.description: Remove @base44/sdk from package.json. Delete src/api/base44Client.js and src/lib/app-params.js. Remove VITE_BASE44_API_KEY from .env.example / vercel env. Extend .hex/adr-rules.toml with a rule forbidding **/*.jsx,tsx from importing @/api/*, @base44/*, or src/adapters/*. Re-run hex analyze — expect zero violations on the extended rule set.
steps.done_condition: package.json has no base44 dependency. src/api/base44Client.js and src/lib/app-params.js deleted. hex analyze passes with extended React boundary rule. bun build succeeds.
